description:
Programme or Project Overview

Utrecht University's Faculty of Veterinary Medicine is hiring a temporary equine veterinarian with a specialisation in reproduction. The position provides clinical cover and specialist input in the equine reproduction unit, working with breeding clients, referring veterinarians and the clinic's veterinary team.

The veterinarian performs and supervises reproductive examinations, treatments and assisted-reproduction procedures in horses, participates in the unit's clinical service rota and contributes to case discussions. The role also includes teaching support for students on clinical placements, given the faculty's integration of care and education.

Candidate profile

Applicants are registered (or eligible for registration as) companion animal or equine veterinarians in the Netherlands, with demonstrable experience or specialist training in equine reproduction. The appointment is a temporary salaried contract on the university's veterinary staff scale with a fixed end date, and the vacancy closes on a fixed date. Proficiency in Dutch for client communication is required, and English is used within the international clinical team.

Highlights

  • Clinical service in equine reproduction
  • Reproductive examinations and assisted-reproduction procedures
  • Client and referring-veterinarian communication
  • Student teaching support on clinical placements
  • Temporary salaried contract, veterinary staff scale
  • Fixed closing date via the Utrecht recruitment portal

Utrecht University is a leading Dutch research university, consistently ranked among the top institutions in Europe.
